short_description: Integrated insurance billing within SimplePractice EHR with electronic claims, ERA posting, and eligibility verification for mental health practices.
long_description: SimplePractice Insurance Billing provides mental health professionals with a streamlined way to submit insurance claims directly from their practice management system. Built into the SimplePractice platform, the billing features include electronic claims submission through Apex EDI and Change Healthcare clearinghouses, real-time eligibility verification, electronic remittance advice (ERA) auto-posting, and automated patient statements. The system supports CMS-1500 claims, handles secondary claims, and provides denial tracking. SimplePractice's AutoPay feature helps practices collect copays and deductibles automatically. Available on Essential and Plus plans, insurance billing adds electronic claims capability without requiring separate billing software, making it ideal for solo practitioners and small practices wanting an all-in-one solution.

pricing.notes: Insurance billing requires Essential ($49/mo) or Plus ($99/mo) plan. Electronic claims $0.25 each or unlimited with Plus plan.

faqs.q: How much does SimplePractice charge per insurance claim?
faqs.a: On the Essential plan ($49/month), SimplePractice charges $0.25 per electronic claim submission. The Plus plan ($99/month) includes unlimited electronic claims at no additional per-claim cost. For practices submitting 200+ claims monthly, the Plus plan becomes more cost-effective.

faqs.q: What clearinghouse does SimplePractice use for claims?
faqs.a: SimplePractice uses Apex EDI and Change Healthcare as their primary clearinghouses for electronic claims submission. These clearinghouses connect to virtually all major insurance payers. Claims typically reach payers within 24-48 hours of submission.

faqs.q: Can SimplePractice handle mental health prior authorizations?
faqs.a: SimplePractice provides eligibility verification that shows prior authorization requirements, but does not automate the prior auth submission process itself. Clinicians need to submit prior authorizations directly to payers through payer portals or phone. The system does track authorization numbers once obtained.

faqs.q: What is SimplePractice's average claim acceptance rate?
faqs.a: SimplePractice reports a high first-pass claim acceptance rate, typically above 95% when claims are entered correctly with verified eligibility. The system includes basic claim scrubbing to catch common errors before submission. However, mental health claims may face additional scrutiny from payers regardless of clearinghouse used.
